summary: Iteration 3 checked the fixes made after iteration 2. Backend: 8 new tests in test_iter3_fixes.py, 7 pass. The 1 failure is the price<=mrp validation, which was an iteration-2 action item but not on this iteration's list. The full regression test_mauli_prod.py passes 28/28, including the 2 that failed in iteration 2 (razorpay stock leak, page=abc). Frontend (Playwright, 1920x1080): /, /enquiry, /product/<slug>, /admin/login, /login and /admin all load with no webpack/eslint overlay and no page errors. The Extras.jsx rules-of-hooks error (seen earlier in the frontend log) is gone: hooks are now unconditional and the latest compile shows warnings only. Admin order sheet for a cancelled order shows the order-cancelled box plus timeline lines (Placed/Confirmed/Cancelled with note and by). Integrations labels are correct and the export buttons read '... .xlsx'. Login shows the otp-not-configured message. The top bar has no secure-payment text. footer-logo and header-logo testids are present. No product card shows '0 ★'. The emi-info box is hidden.

minor.issue: No price <= mrp validation: a product with price 2000 and mrp 1000 is accepted (200). Seed product 'Royal Teak 3 Seater Sofa' still has price 813098 vs MRP 49999, so the PDP shows '-1526% सूट'.
The 'sold' counter only changes on mtype=='sale'. Cancel/return/rollback movements (type 'return') never decrement 'sold', so popularity sorting inflates after cancellations.
Non-atomic pre-checks are kept (harmless, since the atomic adjust_stock guard handles races). POS 400 message may be 'X just went out of stock' or 'Only N in stock', depending on timing.

issues: The 'EMI & Offers' / 'EMI व ऑफर्स' tile (Product.jsx line 143, CreditCard icon) always shows, even when Razorpay is not configured. Only the emi-info box is gated. Gate this tile on settings.razorpay_enabled too.
Home.jsx line 130 always shows the 'secure_pay' item (Secure payments / सुरक्षित पेमेंट), even though the top bar is now gated on razorpay_enabled.

action_items: Add validation price <= mrp in admin product create/update and bulk upload, and fix the Royal Teak 3 Seater Sofa price (813098 > MRP 49999)
Gate the PDP 'EMI & Offers' tile and the Home 'Secure payments' trust item on settings.razorpay_enabled
Optional: decrement 'sold' when stock is returned for cancel/return/rollback

Optional: 5 orphan stock_movements from older runs (name TEST_Chair Pytest / TEST_UI Stool / TEST_CSV Table, created 2026-10-17, products already deleted) remain. Not created in this iteration and not deleted by tester.
critical_code_review_comments: create_order now validates razorpay keys before reserve_lines and rolls back on rzp_order failure. Verified: no stock change and no movement on a 400.

reserve_lines/adjust_stock use a conditional $gte update, so concurrent POS sales (4 threads on 1 unit) gave exactly 1 success and 3 x 400, with stock 0. Concurrent out/damage (4 x qty 2 on stock 3) gave 1 success and 3 x 400, with stock 1.
patch_order: staff gets 403 on payment_status (DB unchanged), staff can still edit notes, manager and owner get 200, unknown id gets 404.
routes_admin.py is 719 lines, above the 700-line guideline. Consider splitting it (POS, exports, CRUD).
